# Overview

The system uses {colors.primary} for primary actions and keeps the UI↔UX journey visible.

## Colors

Use the primary color for the main action and preserve contrast.

## Typography

Body text uses the declared family and readable scale.

## Components

Buttons expose hover, active, pressed, disabled, loading, success, empty, error, and cancellation states. Each state has an accessible name, focus behavior, keyboard operation, and human takeover path.

## Do's and Don'ts

Do preserve visible feedback and recovery; do not hide consequential changes.
